content_sections.heading: About J.C. Bose University
content_sections.text: J.C. Bose University of Science and Technology, YMCA, formerly YMCA University of Science and Technology, is a state government university in Sector-6, Faridabad, Haryana. It was established under State Legislative Act No. 21 of 2009 and is accredited with an 'A+' grade by NAAC.

Haryana State Higher Education Council (HSHEC), Government of Haryana
Dr. Manvi, Associate Professor / Dr. Shilpa, Associate Professor, Department of Computer Science & Applications

content_sections.heading: J.C. Bose University Senior Research Fellow Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian nationals. Master's Degree in a relevant discipline with at least 55% marks (or equivalent grade) from a recognized University/Institution. Two years of research experience in the relevant field. NET/GATE/equivalent qualified, along with knowledge and/or experience in: Data analysis Questionnaire/survey design Statistical analysis Development of web-based/MIS/ERP applications Database management Data visualization Preparation of research reports and documentation Check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made on the basis of an interview. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

rows.information: Office of the Chairperson, Department of Computer Science & Applications
No candidate will be allowed to report after 10:30 AM

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The tenure is two years from the date of appointment. The appointment is purely temporary for two years or co-terminus with the project, subject to satisfactory performance reviewed every three months. The fellowship is liable to cancellation in case of misconduct or unsatisfactory research work, or if the fellow is found ineligible later. The selected candidate will have to work on this project or on any other project-related work assigned by the Principal Investigator from time to time. The selected candidate will have no right to claim regular appointment on the basis of this contract appointment.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for J.C. Bose University Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare your updated CV and supporting documents. Email them to [email protected] by 10 November 2026. Attend the interview at the venue and time given under Selection Process. Bring these to the interview: Photographs All testimonials/documents in original Self-attested copies of the testimonials/documents (set of two)

faq.question: Q1. What marks do I need in my Master's Degree?
faq.answer: You need at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade from a recognized University/Institution.

faq.question: Q2. Is research experience compulsory for this post?
faq.answer: Yes. Two years of research experience in the relevant field is part of the essential qualification.

faq.question: Q3. Is NET or GATE mandatory?
faq.answer: No. NET/GATE/equivalent is listed under Desirable Experience, along with skills such as data analysis and database management.

faq.question: Q4. Where should I send my CV?
faq.answer: Send your updated CV and supporting documents to [email protected].

faq.question: Q5. What happens if I reach the interview after 10:30 AM?
faq.answer: You will not be allowed to report. The reporting time is 9:30 AM, and 10:30 AM is the cut-off.

faq.question: Q6. How many copies of my documents should I carry?
faq.answer: Carry the originals and one set of two self-attested copies, along with your photographs.

faq.question: Q7. Will travel costs be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid.

faq.question: Q8. Can this post become a regular job?
faq.answer: The selected candidate has no right to claim regular appointment on the basis of this contract appointment.
